collision_check: No existing prop-scratch-awl* or prop-brad-awl* FBX or text references; -sa1 suffix free. Existing awls (bodkin-bw1, button-btm1, cobbler, flail-fm1, punch-sv1, scoring-tl1, stitch-gl1, welt-lm1) untouched; new assets are carpenter marking-awl blanks.
judgment_calls: Handle is hex pear-shape with pointed butt at base and flat top for ferrule seat, to stay at 22 tris.
Ferrule is a solid hex collar (no bore) matching handle hex, 20 tris.
Brad blade uses a 9 mm square shank and wedge chisel tip, visibly distinct from the 6 mm square-section scratch spike.
Flat shading; BaseColor PNGs shipped in tex/ unlinked; FBX carries material slots only.
Contact sheet tiles are individually framed, so relative scale between tiles is not to scale.

assets.name: prop-scratch-awl-blade-sa1
assets.desc: Steel scratch-awl blade blank: slender square-section spike, 6 mm square at base tapering to 4 mm at 85 mm then to a sharp pyramid point at 125 mm.

assets.name: prop-scratch-awl-handle-sa1
assets.desc: Wooden hexagonal bulbous handle blank: hex section, pointed butt at base, widest (32 mm across corners) at 40 mm, tapering to an 18 mm flat hex top at 95 mm.

assets.name: prop-scratch-awl-ferrule-sa1
assets.desc: Brass ferrule blank: short solid hexagonal collar, 19 mm across corners, 12 mm tall.

assets.name: prop-brad-awl-blade-sa1
assets.desc: Steel brad-awl blade blank: thick 9 mm square shank to 70 mm, then a wedge chisel tip with a 9 mm straight cutting edge at 90 mm.
